class.name: OcgBrepbuilderapiMakeedge2d
class.description: ! Provides methods to build edges. ! ! The methods have the following syntax, where ! TheCurve is one of Lin2d, Circ2d, ... ! ! Create(C : TheCurve) ! ! Makes an edge on the whole curve. Add vertices ! on finite curves. ! ! Create(C : TheCurve; p1,p2 : Real) ! ! Make an edge on the curve between parameters p1 ! and p2. if p2 < p1 the edge will be REVERSED. If ! p1 or p2 is infinite the curve will be open in ! that direction. Vertices are created for finite ! values of p1 and p2. ! ! Create(C : TheCurve; P1, P2 : Pnt2d from gp) ! ! Make an edge on the curve between the points P1 ! and P2. The points are projected on the curve ! and the previous method is used. An error is ! raised if the points are not on the curve. ! ! Create(C : TheCurve; V1, V2 : Vertex from TopoDS) ! ! Make an edge on the curve between the vertices ! V1 and V2. Same as the previous but no vertices ! are created. If a vertex is Null the curve will ! be open in this direction.

method.name: Error
method.description: Returns the error description when NotDone.

method.name: Vertex1
method.description: Returns the first vertex of the edge. May be Null.

method.name: Vertex2
method.description: Returns the second vertex of the edge. May be Null.
